changelog: v1.4.3 Sony A7M4 Hardware Framerate & Viewfinder Fix: 1) Fixed Sony A7M4 UVC framerate negotiation so it respects hardware supported FPS (30 FPS on 720p, 60 FPS on 1080p) without stalling the camera. 2) Set setZOrderMediaOverlay on SurfaceView to prevent black screen. 3) Prioritizes 1080p modes across all formats.
